summary.text: Idah, on the east bank of the Niger, is the historic capital of the Igala Kingdom and the seat of the Attah Igala. Its people are mainly Igala.

history.text: As a river port on the Niger, Idah linked Lokoja and the north with Onitsha in the south; traders here once paid in bronze rings and cowries. Idah’s war with Benin in 1515 to 1516 is one of the best known events of the kingdom’s history.

livelihoods.text: Fishing and market trade: Idah is an important fishing port and market town on the Niger.
